title: Smart Portal
description: A way to simplify traveling in Minecraft, using Portals
body:
# Smart Portal Datapack
...is a **data pack** to simplify the way of traveling in a **Minecraft** world.
It works simple: You have a _Pearl_ -> You _right click_ it -> A _Portal_ appears to travel

## How to use this Data Pack:
### Crafting the Pearl:
Use one **Ender Pearl** and **4 Blaze powder** and craft them together

### Safing Coordinates:
Hold the **Ender Pearl** in your Hand, _sneak_ and _right click_ it.
Your current **Coordinates** are then safed in the item.

### Build the Portal:
Hold the **Ender Pearl** in your Hand, **DON'T** _sneak_, and _right click_ it.
The **Portal** will now appear and disappears after 25 seconds.
